In [[algebraic topology]], a '''Postnikov square''' is a certain [[cohomology operation]] from a first [[cohomology]] [[group (mathematics)|group]] ''H''<sup>1</sup> to a third cohomology group ''H''<sup>3</sup>, introduced by {{harvs|txt|last=Postnikov|year=1949|authorlink=Mikhail Postnikov}}. {{harvtxt|Eilenberg|1952}} described a generalization taking classes in ''H''<sup>''t''</sup> to&nbsp;''H''<sup>2''t''+1</sup>.
